تضللن (form I)
# تَضْلِلْنَ (taḍlilna) /tadˤ.lil.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of ضَلَّ (ḍalla)
# تُضْلَلْنَ (tuḍlalna) /tudˤ.lal.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of ضَلَّ (ḍalla)
